en.title: GTA 6 Trailer Hides Iconic Tommy Vercetti Nod for Over a Year
en.summary: A seemingly minor detail in Grand Theft Auto 6's second trailer has finally been discovered, revealing a subtle tribute to a legendary Vice City protagonist. This keen observation highlights Rockstar's penchant for deep-cut fan service.
en.body:
It took over a year and hundreds of millions of views, but a dedicated corner of the Grand Theft Auto community has finally unearthed a brilliant Easter egg hidden within the second trailer for **Grand Theft Auto 6**. Spotted by Twitter user GameVerse, a painting of a lizard sporting a blue floral shirt – an unmistakable nod to **Tommy Vercetti**, the protagonist of **Grand Theft Auto: Vice City** – can be glimpsed on a store wall. The detail appears around the 33-second mark, just as the cashier turns his head during a robbery sequence involving co-protagonist **Jason Duvall**. The blink-and-you'll-miss-it nature of the reveal, coupled with the brief visibility and slight blurriness, explains why this detail has remained largely unnoticed for so long.

This discovery is a testament to Rockstar Games' legendary commitment to embedding layers of lore and fan service into their worlds. Given that **Grand Theft Auto 6** is set to return players to the sun-drenched, neon-lit streets of Vice City, it's no surprise that nods to its beloved predecessor would be included. While the presence of **Tommy Vercetti** himself is highly unlikely – especially following the passing of his voice actor, the late **Ray Liotta**, in 2022 – such subtle visual cues connect the new entry to the rich history of the franchise. Rockstar has historically maintained a 'multiverse' approach, separating the timelines of the 2D, 3D, and HD eras of **Grand Theft Auto**, but this Easter egg suggests a more integrated narrative or at least a deep respect for past icons.

## A Year of Silence, A Moment of Discovery

The sheer longevity of this Easter egg remaining undiscovered is remarkable. The second **GTA 6** trailer, released in December 2023, was dissected frame by frame by a global audience eager for any scrap of information about the highly anticipated title. Yet, this specific reference to **Tommy Vercetti**’s iconic outfit from **Vice City** slipped through the cracks. It underscores how even the most analyzed pieces of media can still hold secrets, waiting for the right pair of eyes and perhaps a bit of luck to bring them to light. For fans who grew up with **Vice City**, this small painting represents a significant emotional connection to the past, woven into the fabric of the future of the series.

## What's Next for Vice City's Legacy

With **Grand Theft Auto 6** poised to revisit Vice City, players can anticipate more such references and homages to the franchise's storied past. While **Tommy Vercetti** may not make a physical appearance, his spirit, and the vibrant era he represented, will undoubtedly echo throughout the new game. Fans will undoubtedly continue to pore over every trailer and screenshot, eager to uncover further secrets that bridge the decades of **Grand Theft Auto** history.

tr.title: GTA 6 Fragmanı 1 Yıldan Fazla Süreyle İkonik Tommy Vercetti Nodunu Gizliyordu
tr.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6'nın ikinci fragmanında keşfedilen küçük bir detay, Vice City'nin efsanevi protagonistine saygı duruşunda bulunulduğunu ortaya koyuyor. Bu keşif, Rockstar'ın derin fan servisi için olan yeteneğini vurguluyor. GTA 6, Vice City'ye geri dönecek ve bu nedenle sevilen öncülünün göndermelerini içereceği öngörülüyor.
tr.body:
## GTA 6 Fragmanında Gizli Bir Detay
Grand Theft Auto topluluğunun bir köşesinde, GTA 6'nın ikinci fragmanında gizli bir **Easter egg** keşfedildi. Bu keşif, **Tommy Vercetti**'ye, Grand Theft Auto: Vice City'nin protagonistine bir saygı duruşunda bulunulduğunu gösteriyor. Twitter kullanıcısı GameVerse tarafından keşfedilen bu detay, bir dükkan duvarında mavi çiçekli gömlek giyen bir kertenkele resmini içeriyor. Bu detay, 33. saniyede, **Jason Duvall**'in dahil olduğu bir soygun sahnesinde görünüyor. Bu keşfin bu kadar uzun süre gizli kalması, detayın kısa süreli görünümü ve hafif bulanıklığıyla açıklanabilir.

Bu keşif, Rockstar Games'in dünyalarına katmanlar halinde lore ve fan servisi yerleştirmeye olan taahhüdünü gösteriyor. GTA 6, oyuncuları Vice City'nin güneş altında, neon ışıklarla dolu caddelerine geri getirecek. Bu nedenle, sevilen öncülüne göndermeler içeriyor olması şaşırtıcı değil. **Tommy Vercetti**'nin kendisi muhtemelen görünmeyecek - özellikle seslendirme sanatçısı **Ray Liotta**'nın 2022'de vefat etmesi之后 - ancak bu tür gizli görsel ipuçları, yeni girişi franchise'ın zengin tarihine bağlıyor.

## Bir Yıllık Suskunluk, Bir Anlık Keşif
Bu **Easter egg**'in keşfedilmemesi için gereken süre dikkat çekici. Aralık 2023'te yayınlanan ikinci GTA 6 fragmanı, dünyanın dört bir yanından gelen izleyiciler tarafından analiz edildi. Ancak bu specific **Tommy Vercetti** göndermesi, bu analizlerin arasından sıyrıldı. Bu, даже en çok analiz edilen medya parçalarının hala sırlar taşıyabileceğini ve bu sırların ortaya çıkması için doğru gözlerin ve belki de biraz şansın gerekli olduğunu gösteriyor. **Vice City** ile büyüyen hayranlar için bu küçük resim, geçmişe önemli bir duygusal bağlantı temsil ediyor ve serinin geleceğinin dokusuna işleniyor.

## Vice City'nin Mirasının Geleceği
GTA 6, Vice City'ye geri dönecek ve oyuncular, franchise'ın zengin geçmişine daha fazla gönderme ve saygı bekleyebilir. **Tommy Vercetti** fiziksel olarak görünmeyebilir, ancak onun ruhu ve temsil ettiği canlı dönem, yeni oyunda yankılanacak. Hayranlar, **Grand Theft Auto** tarihini köprüleyen daha fazla sırrı keşfetmek için her fragman ve ekran görüntüsünü incelemeye devam edecek.

content_raw: Grand Theft Auto 6 fans have spotted a cheeky nod to Vice City protagonist Tommy Vercetti in the game's second trailer. In GTA 6's second trailer, we get a mini-montage of a day in the life of co-protagonist Jason Duvall. One key moment sees him walking into a store, slapping the cashier, and taking cash out of the register. However, Twitter user GameVerse spotted something of note. At the 33-second mark of the trailer, right as the cashier turns his head, you can see a painting of a lizard on the wall. The lizard happens to be wearing a blue floral shirt – the same one as Tommy Vercetti from GTA: Vice City. It's somewhat remarkable that this detail has largely gone unnoticed for a year, given the fact that the trailer has hundreds of millions of views and has been hyperanalyzed by fans. However, it's easy to miss since the lizard is obscured until the cashier is slapped, and it's only visible for half a second. It's also just blurry enough that if you're not really looking for it, it may not stand out. It seems like a safe bet to imagine there will be plenty of other references to Grand Theft Auto: Vice City, given that the two titles share a setting. However, you probably shouldn't expect Tommy to show up in the flesh. Not only did actor Ray Liotta pass away in 2022 , but Rockstar has always tried to keep the PS2-era titles separate from the other entries. In response to a fan question back in 2011 , Rockstar revealed its "logic" behind how it separates the different universes but, of course, it could always change this if it really wanted to. "The 'universes' are the worlds interpreted at different definitions, 2D, 3D and high definition, so we felt brands and radio/ said Rockstar. This is the logic (as far as it could be considered logical) behind it – so no, we don’t believe any GTA 3 characters could exist in the GTA 4 universe." GTA 6 will seemingly feature Phil Cassidy , but it doesn't appear to be the same version from the original GTA: Vice City. The new version has both of his arms, which wouldn't be possible if it were the same continuity, given that he blew his arm off in the 80s. GTA 6 will be released on November 19th, 2026, for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Pre-orders will open this Thursday, June 25th . Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team.
